database: MySQL 5.7.13 (repository Dockerfile, V1 and V2 migrations)
warmup: After original DB-backed tests/e2e attempts, 100 sequential rounds of GET /config/sentry, /api/tracking/stats, /consumers/1, /restaurants/1 (400 HTTP 200 responses); then jcmd PID GC.run and jstat -gc PID 1000 1
jstat_gc_raw: S0C    S1C    S0U    S1U      EC       EU        OC         OU       MC     MU    CCSC   CCSU   YGC     YGCT    FGC    FGCT     GCT
measurement_notes: One local VM sample, not a load/performance assertion.
Heap usage is estimated from jstat KiB values, not RSS; jstat is taken immediately after a requested full GC.
Use the same heap flags, database and warmup for AB-573 comparisons.
